describe.description: The creature is a large upright-standing chimera shown in profile facing right, with the head and shaggy mane of a lion on top, a spotted feline body and hindquarters, and two large outstretched feathered wings in place of forelimbs. Its upper chest and neck are covered in overlapping brown and tan feathers, its lower torso, hind legs and long tail are covered in tawny fur with dark rosette spots, and it stands on two muscular hind legs with its wings spread wide to the sides.

describe.description: A large upright creature with the head and shaggy mane of a male lion, a neck and upper chest covered in dense overlapping brown-gold feathers, two large outspread feathered bird wings, a lean spotted feline torso and hindquarters, standing on two muscular spotted hind legs ending in feline paws, with a long slender spotted tail ending in a dark tuft. No forelimbs are visible.
